descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S14 「搜索能找到第一页 50 条之外的病人，两个模式」 Search finds a patient beyond the first page of 50, both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given 51 Hospital patients in rooms 1–51 plus one in room 999; 51 residents in Rm 1–51 plus one in Rm 999, all on today's list

When Search 'Zuniga' on the Hospital list; search 'Zeller' on Today's Visits and on All Residents

Then The searched patient (52nd in room order, outside the first page) is listed and no message says nothing matches

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：cp1 mustContain 'QA Hosp Zuniga', mustNotContain 'No patients match'; cp2 and cp3 mustContain 'QA Resident Zeller', mustNotContain 'No residents match' (U1, U4). Server-side sparse paging is also covered by S05 (Hospital) and S06 (Nursing Home)

在哪跑：dev 单元 U72；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S14

Search finds a patient beyond the first page of 50, both contexts

Tickets: TFA-92581 Search & Sort (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U72.verdict.json), unit U72. Agent: 20 turns, 73 s, $0.33.

Plan said: matrix-gap: legacy spec, needs[] not annotated — this run has a result anyway, so the result is shown.

Plan: unit U72 (#72, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Search beyond the first 50, both contexts. Whole-list order / search checks: its own seed only (matrix-gap fix 2026-10-14).

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #72, U72; checked: yes): Pass — 104 rows: lists show 50 + 'Load more'; search finds the 52nd (Zuniga, Zeller) on Hospital, Today's Visits and All Residents. 104 deleted
